[Shot 1] The video opens on a slow push-in framed tight on the rain-covered window of <Subject 2>, the roughly ten-square-metre study, so that wet glass, sliding droplets and the blurred orange-red neon beyond it fill the frame; <Subject 3>, the amber interior light against the cold blue night, is already readable in the reflections travelling across the glass. The camera pushes forward along the depth axis at a slow even rate while the focus racks outward from the glass surface to the distant city, so the water beads and streaks soften into bokeh and the far towers and neon signs sharpen into distinct shapes. The dark window frame, the head of the black desk lamp and the near edge of the dark wooden desk slide into the lower frame as the push continues. Rain ticks and hisses steadily on the glass. He types on the laptop keyboard with both hands, fingertips moving in a steady rhythm while his shoulders and neck stay still and slightly forward; the cold white screen light outlines his cheek, ear, shoulder and knuckles, and the amber lamp light holds the back of his neck, the chair back and the sideboard behind him. The backward dolly continues and settles into a medium shot that keeps the rain window, the warm desk lamp, the open laptop and the potted plants on the left wall inside the frame. Soft close keyboard clatter rides under the rain outside.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a tight close-up of his hands and the black keyboard. His fingertips tap a few quick strokes, then his right index finger shifts to the backspace key and presses it several times in a row, each press landing as its own soft click; the cold white glow of the screen spills over his knuckles and the keycaps. After the last press he pauses for one beat, then both hands withdraw from the keyboard and come to rest flat on the desk edge with the fingers relaxing, and the typing sound stops. The shallow depth of field leaves the lit screen soft behind his hands.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up from his front three-quarter side: <Subject 1> in the plain white T-shirt, with the rain window and the amber desk lamp behind him. He leans back until his back and shoulder blades settle against the chair back, tilts his head slightly upward, closes his eyes for a moment and releases a slow breath, the keyboard left untouched on the desk in front of him; the wet window light and the amber lamp trace the side of his face, the edge of his hair and his collarbone. Only the rain and the faint indoor room tone remain audible as the shot holds to the end.

Steady light rain ticks and hisses against the window glass throughout the whole video, with soft close keyboard clatter under it during the typing shots and a faint indoor room tone beneath everything.

- 模型: minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors
- 采样: euler + simple, 4 步; shift 12.0/3.0; Sage 加速(H3 专用)
- 帧数 = 秒数x24 对齐 17k+5 网格
- 输出: 24fps
- 切换: FallingTSSwitch — True=4步 (上方采样参数: turbo LoRA + euler + shift 6/3)
                          False=20步 (无 LoRA + res_multistep + simple + 模型默认 shift, 不经 SigmaShift)
- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
